judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core validation logic in `ToolRegistry` and passes the functional requirements, though it overcomplicates the implementation by stripping schema keywords via `validationSchema` and handling legacy Ajv v6 `dataPath` formats when Ajv v8 is installed. It also misses logging a warning on validation failure, which makes the log-redaction test trivially pass by emitting no logs at all. Several explicit acceptance criteria were left unfinished (as noted in the candidate's own `.lore/dod.md`), including updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and adding the tool-loop test directly to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Finally, the `.lore/dod.md` artifact was left in the diff.
